verdict.rationale: Convex's docs say it intentionally has no opinionated RLS-style framework. Instead, its flexibility lets developers build their own authorization layer in server-side TypeScript functions, paired with auth via Convex Auth or providers such as Clerk, Auth0 and WorkOS. Per-user restriction is therefore possible, but only as hand-written function logic, not as declarative policies or security rules. Missing for 10: built-in declarative row-level security policies or security rules, documentation of how per-user checks are written in functions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of per-user access control.
